capture.title: Capture
capture.tipsWide: Use a wide, stable view of the rink or playing surface.
capture.tipsJersey: Keep your jersey number clearly visible.
capture.tipsLines: Include rink lines and boards when filming for speed stats.
capture.maxDurationNoSubscription: Max clip length: 0 - No subscription yet
capture.subscriptionRequired: Uploads require an active Morphos subscription. Subscribe on the Morphos website — Apple and Google are not involved in billing.
capture.guardianManagesFootage: Your guardian manages new footage. Ask them to add video from the Morphos website.
capture.signInRequiredBody: Sign in with Google, Microsoft, or Apple to capture video, load calendar events, and upload to Morphos.

schedule.title: Schedule
schedule.empty: No schedule events found for this athlete.
schedule.emptyTeam: No schedule events found for this team.

qc.subject_not_visible: The athlete is not visible enough in this clip.
qc.jersey_not_visible: Jersey number is not clear enough.
qc.too_blurry: Video is too blurry. Hold the phone steady and refocus.
qc.too_shaky: Video is too shaky. Use a stable mount or rest your arms.
qc.too_dark: Video is too dark. Move to better lighting.
qc.overrideAck: Upload anyway (analysis quality may be reduced)

upload.title: Upload
upload.success: Video uploaded and queued for analysis.
upload.statPickHint: The list is the full athlete catalogue. This film measures only the stats you pick.
upload.teamFullStats: This Development or Elite team game processes every tiered athlete stat.
upload.teamStarterStats: A Starter team game does not process the full athlete stat set.

videos.title: My videos
videos.empty: No videos yet. Capture or import a clip to get started.

account.title: Account
account.signInHint: Sign in with the same Google, Microsoft, or Apple account you use on the Morphos website.

metadata.locationNeeded: Location permission is needed to find nearby venues. You can still search for a venue by name.
metadata.locationUnavailable: Could not read your location. Try again outdoors or enable location services, or search for a venue by name.
metadata.locationServicesOff: Location services are turned off. Turn them on to find nearby venues, or search for a venue by name.
metadata.noNearbyVenue: No venues with map coordinates were found near you. Search for a venue by name or show all regions.
metadata.noVenuesMatch: No venues match your search. Try a different name or show all regions.

eventLink.label: Calendar event
eventLink.notLinked: Not linked to a calendar event
eventLink.signInRequired: Sign in to load your team and personal calendar events.
eventLink.empty: No calendar events were found for your athlete profile.
eventLink.emptyTeam: No calendar events were found for this team.

auth.title: Sign in to Morphos
auth.subtitle: Use the same Google, Microsoft, or Apple account as the Morphos website. You stay signed in on this device.
auth.googleUnavailable: Google sign-in is not available on this server right now. Use Microsoft or Apple instead.
auth.appleUnavailable: Apple sign-in is not available on this server right now. Use Google or Microsoft instead.
auth.googleNativeClientMisconfigured: Google blocked this sign-in. Verify the Morphos Capture {platform} OAuth client in Google Cloud Console (package/bundle + SHA-1 for Android).
auth.microsoftRedirectUnregistered: Microsoft could not return to Morphos Capture. Add this return address as a public-client redirect in Entra: {uri}

errors.video_too_long: This clip exceeds your plan's maximum length.
errors.transcode_failed: Couldn't prepare this video for upload. Try again.
errors.network: Network error. Check your connection and try again.
errors.sessionExpired: Your session expired. Sign out and sign in again.

home.title: Home
home.emptyBody: Subscribe on the Morphos website to upload video for your athletes and teams.
home.shareInviteBody: Scan the QR code or share your invite link so others can join Morphos.
home.shareInviteLoadFailed: Couldn't load your invite link. Pull to refresh on Home and try again.
